item.title: SA-CP – Zero-Cost Sovereign Co-Pilot Extension for Chrome
item.summary: We built SA-CP (Sovereign Antigravity Co-Pilot), an open-source Chrome Extension that bridges local IDE Agent free intelligence to your browser side panel with zero API cost. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Team-Sequence-Thaumaturge/sa-cp Official Portal: https://salabs.quanxs.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49159275 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
